list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List the users in the Awardco account, with their employee ids, names and status -- the starting point for reconciling a directory.

output.description: The account's users.

create_user.title: Create a user
create_user.description: Add a user to Awardco. employeeId, firstName and lastName are required; set notify to have Awardco email them about the new account.

employee_id.description: Employee id for the new user.

preferred_first_name.description: Name the user prefers to be called.

notify.description: True to email the user about their new account.

output.description: Confirmation that the user was created.

check_user_exists.title: Check whether a user exists
check_user_exists.description: Ask whether Awardco already knows a person, identified by employee id, username or email -- exactly one of the three.

output.description: Whether the user exists.

get_user_balance.title: Get a user's points balance
get_user_balance.description: Read how many points a user currently holds, identified by employee id, username or email.

output.description: The user's current points balance.

activate_user.title: Activate a user
activate_user.description: Reactivate an archived user so they can sign in and be recognised again. Identify them by employee id, username or email.

employee_id.description: Employee id of the user to activate.

username.description: Username of the user to activate.

email.description: Email address of the user to activate.

output.description: Confirmation that the user was activated.

archive_user.title: Archive a user
archive_user.description: Archive a user, which is how a leaver is switched off -- they keep their history but can no longer sign in or receive recognition.

employee_id.description: Employee id of the user to archive.

username.description: Username of the user to archive.

email.description: Email address of the user to archive.

output.description: Confirmation that the user was archived.

reset_user_password.title: Reset a user's password
reset_user_password.description: Set a new password for a user, identified by employee id, username or email.

output.description: Confirmation that the password was reset.

upload_profile_pictures.title: Upload profile pictures
upload_profile_pictures.description: Set profile pictures for up to 50 users in one call. Each entry pairs an employee id with the picture to store.

upload.description: Entries of employeeID and profilePicture, at most 50.

output.description: Per-user results for the upload.

recognize.title: Recognize users through a program
recognize.description: Award recognition under a configured recognition program, which decides eligibility, notifications and how points are funded. Name the program by id or name, and give budgetName whenever amount is above zero and the program bills a budget.

recipients.description: Employee ids, emails or usernames -- one kind per call.

note.description: The recognition message shown to the recipient and on the feed.

recognition_program_id.description: Id of the recognition program to award under.

recognition_program_name.description: Name of the recognition program, instead of its id.

giver.description: Who is giving the recognition; must be eligible under the program.

title.description: Headline shown above the recognition note.

amount.description: Cash value of the award in the program's currency.

budget_name.description: Budget to fund the award from, when amount is above zero.

tag_names.description: Tags to attach, such as company values.

is_public.description: Whether the recognition appears on the public feed.

output.description: Confirmation of the recognition, per recipient.

recognize_freeform.title: Recognize users without a program
recognize_freeform.description: Award recognition outside any program. Because no program supplies the defaults, emailTemplateName is needed whenever sendNotifications is on, and budgetName whenever amount is above zero.

recipients.description: Employee ids, emails or usernames -- one kind per call.

note.description: The recognition message shown to the recipient and on the feed.

giver.description: Who is giving the recognition; defaults to the company when empty.

amount.description: Cash value of the award in the company's base currency.

budget_name.description: Budget to fund the award from, when amount is above zero.

email_template_name.description: Email template to notify recipients with; needed when sending notifications.

tag_names.description: Tags to attach to the recognition.

is_public.description: Whether the recognition appears on the public feed.

output.description: Confirmation of the recognition, per recipient.

create_external_recognition.title: Record an external recognition
create_external_recognition.description: Post recognition that happened somewhere else into the Awardco feed -- from a chat tool or another system. toPartyIdentifier lets Awardco match the person when the email alone is not enough.

user_email.description: Email of the person being recognised.

note.description: The recognition message to show on the feed.

to_party_identifier.description: Identifier for the recipient in the originating system.

external_recognition_program_url.description: URL of the external program the recognition belongs to.

output.description: Confirmation that the external recognition was recorded.

get_social_feed.title: Get the social feed
get_social_feed.description: Read a page of the public recognition feed -- who recognised whom, for what, and when.

page.description: Page of the feed to read.

output.description: A page of recognitions from the feed.

get_custom_feed.title: Get the custom feed
get_custom_feed.description: Read public recognitions filtered by user metadata -- department, region and the like -- as a JSON array of filter clauses in metadataFilter.

page.description: Page of the feed, up to 100,000.

metadata_filter.description: JSON array of metadata filters, e.g. ["Product","Engineering"].

output.description: A page of matching recognitions.

get_custom_feed_filter_values.title: Get the custom feed's filter values
get_custom_feed_filter_values.description: List the values the custom feed's metadata filter accepts. Nothing comes back until a metadata filter has been configured on the account.

output.description: The available metadata filter values.

get_report_data.title: Pull a report synchronously
get_report_data.description: Pull a named report in one call, optionally narrowed by a time range, filters and chosen columns. Rate limited to 5 requests a minute; for anything large, use the asynchronous v2 flow instead.

report_name.description: Name of the report to pull; see get_report_info for what it accepts.

return_type.description: Format to return the data in.

time_range_option.description: Named time range, which overrides startDate and endDate.

start_date.description: First record date, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

end_date.description: Last record date, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

include_record_count.description: True to add a Record-Count header to the response.

data_filters.description: Filters to apply across the data set.

content_columns.description: Columns to return for each matching record.

output.description: The report's rows in the requested format.

get_report_info.title: Get a report's available options
get_report_info.description: Discover what a named report supports -- its columns and filters, and with includesValues the values each filter accepts. Rate limited to 5 requests a minute.

report_name.description: Name of the report to describe.

includes_values.description: True to include every possible value for each filter.

output.description: The report's columns, filters and, optionally, filter values.

get_report_info_v2.title: Get a report's options (v2)
get_report_info_v2.description: Read the v2 description of a report by id -- its standard columns, dynamic column categories, filter categories and supported time zones. Call this before start_report_task.

output.description: The report's columns, categories, filters and time zones.

get_report_dynamic_columns.title: Get a report's dynamic columns
get_report_dynamic_columns.description: List up to the top 100 selectable columns in one dynamic column category, which is how metadata-driven columns are discovered. Narrow with searchQuery when there are more than 100.

search_query.description: Text to match against column names.

output.description: The selectable dynamic columns in that category.

get_report_filter_options.title: Get a report's filter values
get_report_filter_options.description: List up to the top 100 selectable values for one filter category, and any nested sub-categories under it.

filter_sub_option_id.description: Nested filter option whose values to list.

search_query.description: Text to match against filter values.

output.description: The selectable values for that filter category.

start_report_task.title: Start a report task (v2)
start_report_task.description: Queue a report by id and get back a task to poll. Set paginate for large reports, which splits the result into 10 MB pages, and choose the output format with the Accept header. Rate limited to 5 requests a minute.

accept.description: Format the finished report should come back in.

time_range_option.description: Named range such as today or this week, instead of explicit dates.

start_date.description: First record date, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

end_date.description: Last record date, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

time_range_date_columns.description: Which date columns the time range applies to.

time_zone.description: Time zone to evaluate the dates in. Defaults to UTC.

selected_filters.description: Filters to apply, keyed by filter category.

paginate.description: True to split the report into 10 MB pages.

report_group_by.description: Grouping for the Recognition Limit Utilization report.

report_group_by_metadata_name.description: Metadata field to group that report by.

output.description: The queued task, with the id to poll.

get_report_task_status.title: Check a report task's status
get_report_task_status.description: Poll a queued report until it is ready. A finished paginated report reports its page count and the URLs its pages are fetched from. Rate limited to 12 requests a minute.

output.description: The task's status and, when ready, its pagination details.

get_report_page.title: Retrieve a report page
get_report_page.description: Download one page of a finished paginated report, by task id and page number.

task_id.description: Task id of the completed report.

page.description: Page number to fetch, from 1 to the task's page count.

output.description: That page of the report, in the format the task requested.

get_data_warehouse_refresh_date.title: Get the data warehouse refresh date
get_data_warehouse_refresh_date.description: Read when Awardco's data warehouse was last refreshed, so you can tell whether a report will already include recent activity.

output.description: The warehouse's last refresh timestamp.
